title: Book Three · Chapter 147: Ten Days Before
story:
On Wednesday, the visit is ten days away.

Ronan asks Anna to sit with him after lunch. He puts his notebook beside her visitor sheet.

“I am keeping the work morning,” he says.

Anna looks at the two dates.

“So you can't come.”

“No.”

He takes a breath.

“I said ‘we’ too quickly. I didn't check my own dates first. The work dates were in my notebook.”

She is quiet for a moment.

“I wanted you there.”

“I wanted that too. Mr Sun can change the collections if I stop. But I want to finish the three mornings.”

Anna closes his notebook gently and moves it back toward him.

“My mum can come. We talked last night.”

Ronan nods. He looks at her name on the sheet.

“You should see the rooms.”

“I want to.”

“I know.”

Neither smiles at once. Then Anna takes out another small page.

“I have saved the present return fare. Twelve yuan. We still need to check the buses near the date.”

“And food?”

“We can bring lunch. Mum will keep some extra money too. She is paying for her own journey.”

Ronan looks at the blank line below Anna's name. Her mother has written her name on another piece of paper for the request.

“I nearly offered to pay for us,” he says.

Anna looks at him.

“You didn't ask what we had planned.”

“No. I started with we.”

She rests her hand beside his. He moves his fingers close enough to touch hers.

She turns her hand over and takes his. Near them, Kai knocks a pencil toward the edge of his desk. Ronan catches it before it falls. Anna laughs at Kai's surprised face.

“Tell me about the visit afterward?” he asks.

“Yes.”

She picks up the pages. The request will have her name and her mother's. Ronan's name will not take a place.

That afternoon, Anna posts the names and asks for confirmation. Ronan goes to Mr Sun before he walks home.

“I will be here for all three mornings,” he says.

Mr Sun checks the last date and thanks him. Ronan puts the notebook away.

At the gate, he sees the woman from yesterday with her parcel open on the counter. She is explaining a handle to Dad.

Ronan waves to him, then goes home. He has school work waiting. Anna has her own drawing pages, and a journey she now plans with her mother.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

return fare＝往返车费；confirmation＝确认回复；offer＝主动提出；request＝请求、申请参观的信。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan提前多少天说清不能同行？是在付款或占用他的参观名额之后才说的吗？
2. Anna将与谁同行、谁付哪一部分？她有没有因此放弃参观？

## 读句子

**Anna looks at the two dates.**

拆开看：Anna / looks at / the two dates.

Anna／看着／纸上的那两个日期。
